en:
Let's pick a mascot and club name.
Left/Right: mascot, Up/Down: club name
A Button: confirm.

Let's choose the club flag. Left/Right
sets the design, Up/Down the colour.
The kit will match the flag.

Happy with the club?
You can't change it after
confirming, so be careful.

A club was founded at the same time as
us, named @Y/"#R_TE#"@.
They should make good rivals.
